title: Is Your NPU Ready for LLMs? Dissecting the Hidden Efficiency Bottlenecks in Mobile LLM Inference
abstract: arXiv:2607.05475v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Deploying Large Language Models (LLMs) on mobile devices enhances privacy and reduces latency, but is severely constrained by hardware inefficiencies. We present the first comprehensive, cross-layer measurement study of mobile LLM inference, spanning five mainstream frameworks (e.g., llama.cpp and GENIE) and three hardware backends (CPU, GPU, and NPU). To enable this analysis, we develop PowerBench, a fine-grained profiling tool that measures LLM throughput and provides the first backend-specific energy attribution for mobile LLM inference, going beyond traditional device-level measurements. translated_title: 你的NPU准备好迎接大语言模型了吗？剖析移动端LLM推理中隐藏的效率瓶颈
translated_abstract: 将大语言模型（LLM）部署到移动设备上可以增强隐私保护并降低延迟，但受到硬件效率低下的严重制约。我们提出了首个全面的、跨层次的移动端LLM推理测量研究，涵盖了五个主流框架（如llama.cpp和GENIE）以及三种硬件后端（CPU、GPU和NPU）。为实现这一分析，我们开发了PowerBench，这是一种细粒度的性能分析工具，能够测量LLM吞吐量，并首次为移动端LLM推理提供针对特定后端的能耗归因，超越了传统的设备级测量。我们进一步开展了硬件微基准测试，以表征移动端CPU、GPU和NPU的内存系统性能与计算能力。我们的研究得出了三个关键见解：（1）由于卸载策略、硬件等方面的差异，框架导致的性能差距在NPU上被大幅放大，最高可达10倍。
tldr: 该论文开展了首个跨层次的移动端LLM推理全面测量研究，并开发了细粒度性能分析工具PowerBench，揭示了框架性能差距在NPU上可被放大至10倍等隐藏的效率瓶颈。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first comprehensive cross-layer measurement study of mobile LLM inference and develops PowerBench, a fine-grained profiling tool, revealing hidden efficiency bottlenecks such as framework-induced performance gaps amplified up to 10x on NPUs.
